notes: DeepFlux 9.4 - VOD downloads work on far more IPTV playlists: sources whose videos hide behind dated stream URLs (no movie keywords, plain .m3u8 links - e.g. non-English adult libraries) are now recognized as Movies instead of Live TV, so the Download button finally appears on them. Existing sources pick up the fix after a refresh in Play -> Sources. Includes all 9.0-9.3 features.
